subject: Coord: demo slot, stakeholders, and evidence owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <avery@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-discovery: suggested demo windows + owners (Nimbus Health)

Hi Avery — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we have a single thread for scheduling: 

- Recap: You’re evaluating inference hosting for care-delivery analytics (low-latency normals + strong data governance). Main stakeholders: Platform (Devon), Security (unnamed), Procurement (Proc team).
- Proposed next step: 60-minute technical deep dive/demo with our infra + SSO/PII controls, and a short Q&A with security/procurement present.

Proposed 3 windows (PST):
  • Tue Dec 7, 10:00–11:00
  • Wed Dec 8, 13:00–14:00
  • Thu Dec 9, 08:00–09:00

Can you confirm which slot works best or propose 1–2 alternatives? If possible, please add Devon (platform) and Devon’s procurement contact so we can get purchasing scope on the calendar. 

I’m attaching a short PoC playbook and the SSO checklist so your platform/security folks can scan ahead. If there are any compliance artifacts you want before the session (SOC/retention), flag them here and I’ll route to Soojin.

Attachments: Redwood-PoC-playbook.pdf; SSO-Requirements.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AM, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Dec 2027 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: suggested demo windows + owners (Nimbus Health)

Perfect — Tue 7th at 10:00 PST is on our side. I’ve locked a provisional invite to hold the time. I’m adding Soojin (Head of Security Integrations) and Karthik (Procurement lead) on cc so they can decide which artifacts to bring and who from Nimbus we’ll need on the procurement thread. 

Soojin / Karthik — quick context: Nimbus Health is evaluating Redwood for a low-latency inference surface with strict data governance. We’ll run through architecture, SSO/KV caching implications, and a short procurement/terms Q&A. Please see the attached PoC playbook and SSO checklist. Would you prefer the security portion to be in the first 20 minutes of the demo or as a separate 30-minute follow-up after the platform walkthrough? Also, Karthik — procurement will want an initial list of contracting items and a high-level pricing punchlist; can you confirm what you need from them (billing entity, anticipated volumes, PO timelines)?

Next steps (for clarity):
- Marissa to send invite + base deck and HubSpot link (done)
- Soojin to flag any compliance docs (SOC2, retention policy) needed prior to demo
- Karthik to send list of contracting inputs (billing entity + expected scale)
- Avery to confirm procurement contact (you mentioned Devon Price)

Attachments: Redwood-PoC-playbook.pdf; SSO-Requirements.xlsx

Best —
Marissa

Thanks all — Devon and I can confirm Dec 7 at 10am PST. Devon will attend from platform and I’ve looped our procurement lead (Devon Price) for the purchasing questions you called out. Procurement has requested an NDA and a short pricing snapshot before the procurement call; I attached our signed NDA here.

Quick notes:
- Devon (platform) will bring the list of their current infra constraints and a short SSO note.
- Procurement (Devon Price) requests: billing entity name, expected monthly token estimate (or Q1 estimate), and whether Redwood supports PO + net30 (or custom terms).

Attached: NDA-NimbusHealth-signed.pdf

See you on Dec 7 at 10:00 PST — invite should be up shortly.
